about.title: Clinical care and architecture,
about.p1: Physical Therapy graduate (ICES, Xalapa). Experience with special-needs populations in Mexico, the United States and interdisciplinary settings, including speech therapy and inclusion camps with Citizens Options Unlimited.
about.p2: I apply clinical reasoning and evidence-based practice to design PoncePretelin's architecture: referenced test values, EBP scales, IASP and WHO ICF terminology, safety integrations and AI modules as support — not a substitute for professional judgment.

project.leadPrefix: with AI and referenced evidence — not empty forms.
project.engine1Desc: Multi-specialty, episodes, SOAP notes and clinic workflows. Active v1 with records, scheduling and patient portal.
project.engine2Desc: openFDA and RxNav integration for device alerts and medication context. Clinical decision support — not a replacement for institutional protocols.
project.engine3Desc: ~980 referenced terms (IASP, WHO ICF). Language alignment in notes and reports. Standalone MVP.

flows.f2Desc: Apply NDI or ODI, view evidence-based interpretation and progress in the record.
flows.f3Desc: Checker with ~980 IASP · WHO ICF terms · person-centered language.

why.title: Not a generic
why.lead: Empty forms vs clinical automations with referenced sources and prudent language.
why.c1Desc: Test sensitivity and specificity with literature-referenced values — not invented or randomly generated.
why.c2Desc: ~980 versioned referenced terms: IASP 2020, WHO ICF, person-centered language. MVP for notes and reports.
why.c3Desc: AI modules for imaging and clinical assistance integrated into the record — support tool, not a substitute for professional judgment.
